# Mevlana Yalçın — Yankı Verification Engine & AI Engineering

AI product studio and consultancy in Ankara. Creators of Yankı (MIT): deterministic multilingual LLM quote-grounding, RAG citation verification, and live Claude reflection.

## Identity
Mevlana Yalçın is a founder-led AI product engineering studio and consultancy based in Ankara, Türkiye. We build Yankı—an open-source (MIT) multilingual quote-grounding and RAG citation verification engine paired with a live edge reflection sandbox—and help engineering teams integrate, verify and benchmark LLM systems.
Mevlana Yalçın operates this AI consulting and product development business. Enquiries and engagement terms are handled directly by the founder.
The business was registered in November 2023. The founder has held mevlanayalcin.com.tr since September 2023. Product and verification engine work on Yankı began in October 2026.

## Open-Source Software & Live Product
- **Yankı Verification Engine (`yanki` v0.2.0, MIT License)**: Deterministic multilingual LLM quote-grounding (`verify_quote_grounding`), index-preserving Turkish `İ/ı` Unicode offset mapping (`yanki.normalize`), multi-source RAG citation verification (`verify_multi_source_citations`), pre-inference crisis guardrails (`yanki.guardrails`), `<think>`-aware strict JSON schema validation (`yanki.schema`), and unified `vLLM`/`SGLang`/OpenAI/Anthropic benchmark harness (`24/24` passing in CI).
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mevlanayalcin/yanki
- **Live Zero-Retention Edge Sandbox**: https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/work/yanki/ (`POST /api/reflect`, `GET /api/health`)
